subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/page_alloc: only skip kswapd nodes below their kswapd watermark

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewer Lorenzo raised concerns about code duplication and complexity, noting that the new condition added to the branch already has a massive comment and duplicates existing code. He suggested cleaning up the code by removing duplicated blocks and following established conventions for watermark checks.
reviews.raw_body:
I know this code is hardly the cleanest, but you're now adding a 3rd condition
to a branch that was already complicated enough to have a massive comment and
duplicating a block of code that already dupliclated twice here.

You're also then going against the convention of

	mark = ...
	if (... !zone_watermark_fast(zone, order, mark,
					 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags,
					 gfp_mask)) {

(Obviously yours varies on alloc_flags too)

And also inlining the mark value.

Could you clean this up a little given this isn't a fix?

In general extending functionality should pay down some technical debt if
possible, it's ok to add a preceding patch in the series to do something like
that.

reviews.author: Joshua Hahn (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the check for kswapd nodes should be folded into a helper function and agreed to restructure in a new series of patches.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Lorenzo,

Thanks for taking a look at the patches! I think your requests are
valid here, let me fold that whole check into a helper function
including the comment block and hopefully that will make
get_page_from_freelist() a bit easier to read @_@. I also found an
unused gfp argument anyways, so I'll fold in some related cleanups and
send a new series.

I'll wait until tomorrow to send it out to see if other folks have
concerns with this. Thanks again, have a great day!
Joshua

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's page allocation mechanism to prevent kswapd thrashing on a node when it has plenty of free memory. The existing fix only skipped nodes where kswapd was active, but this caused pressure on other nodes. This patch adds an additional check to ensure that a node is not skipped if its zone is below the watermark for the current request. This prevents both piling up pressure on one node and preventing allocation on other nodes due to continuous kswapd activity.
